info.title: UK Parliament Members API
info.description: Official, keyless. Who represents a constituency, for which party, and by what margin at the last election — including the party's brand colour for rendering.

get.summary: Find a constituency by name, with its current MP and party
get.description: `items[].value` carries `id` (for electionResult), `name`, and `currentRepresentation.member.value` with `nameDisplayAs` and `latestParty` (name, abbreviation, backgroundColour). Search with the constituency name postcodes.io returned.

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The constituency name, e.g. 'Greenwich and Woolwich'.

get.summary: The seat's latest general-election result — winner, majority, turnout, every candidate
get.description: `value` carries `result` ('Lab Hold', 'Con Gain'…), `majority`, `electorate`, `turnout`, `winningParty` and `candidates[]` with `votes` and `voteShare`.
